segments.normalizedSource: ``` def loss_fn(w): return 0.5 * mx.mean(mx.square(X @ w - y)) grad_fn = mx.grad(loss_fn) ```

```
    grad = grad_fn(w)
    w = w - lr * grad
    mx.eval(w)
```

```
loss = loss_fn(w)
```
